ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a ratio of approximately 3:2 white-to-black pixels on the visible left lobe ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zone occupies the center and upper-medial region of the left lobe. Thick black marginal banding (approx. 15-20% width) along the trailing edge and outer tip. Dense black mottling and focal spots are clustered along the lower leading edge and medial boundary of the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge presents low-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations. Right lobe distal edge presents high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys consistent with significant tissue erosion or heavy barnacle encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a smooth convex curvature along the outer margin. Right lobe sweep is truncated and irregular at the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured cluster of white and brownish-grey circular pixel groups localized on the distal 20% of the right lobe lobe. Sparse dark focal spots (mottling) distributed across the white ventral field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four roughly parallel, vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) localized in the lower-central white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular morphological loss and heavy parasitic/calcified loading on the right lobe tip, contrasting with the relatively smooth left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Marked bilateral asymmetry in tip integrity between the left and right lobes.
